result.summary: Current encounter involves alcoholic cirrhosis with ascites, bleeding esophageal varices treated endoscopically, and a hemorrhagic gastrojejunal ulcer; monitor for recurrent bleeding and anemia (latest hemoglobin 7.3 g/dL, platelets 82 K/uL). ESRD with dialysis dependence requires access to intermittent hemodialysis, performed September 21. Mechanical ventilation and central lines were documented only in prior encounters; no current respiratory devices, IV drips, or specific vascular access are supported.
result.contact_isolation_reason: No organism or explicit precaution supporting contact isolation; remote nonspecific yeast cultures do not establish a current contact-isolation need.
